maria (sales): Heads-up: Prospective customer Nimbus Corp asked if we can run a 4-week air-gapped POC. Main asks: signed offline artifacts, small delta patches during maintenance windows, HSM support for key verification, and an auditable upgrade log. Any red flags?
tom (sales-eng): No blockers technically. They will run RHEL 9 on locked-down VMs, internal registry only, no Internet. Need clarity on how we deliver updates (physical media, internal S3, or scp).
lina (solutions): We support three workflows: 1) On-demand signed tarball (customer pulls via secure transfer), 2) Staged diff bundles we produce and they fetch during a maintenance window, 3) Provision a transient staging node (with limited egress) to pull diffs, then that node seals artifacts into the cluster. Each has tradeoffs for automation and audit.
aleks (security): Requirements checklist from security POV: SBOM for entire bundle, signature verifiable by customer KMS public key, FIPS libs if they require, and evidence of manifest checksums + attestation chain. Also, retention policy for upgrade logs.
maria (sales): They asked about upgrade cadence: they expect monthly security updates but only quarterly feature upgrades. Can we do that?
tom (sales-eng): Yes. We can produce micro-bundles for security fixes (small patches) monthly and larger feature bundles quarterly. For maintenance windows under 3 hours we recommend pre-staging models/artifacts as part of the POC.
lina (solutions): Rollback plan we use: keep previous manifest and component checksums on nodes. Upgrade script is idempotent and can switch back to previous manifest. Demo snippet we can show: 
```
# apply micro-bundle
rdx-upgrade --apply /tmp/rdx-micro-2026-03-15.tar.gz --manifest /tmp/manifest.yml
# rollback
rdx-upgrade --rollback --to-manifest manifest-2026-02-01.yml
```
maria (sales): Pricing: Nimbus wants to know if airgap packaging changes pricing. Also asks about an initial engineering effort.
tom (sales-eng): Suggest one-time POC packaging fee to cover offline bundling + automation (~est. 3-5 engineer days). After POC, we can include delta generation in standard support for enterprise customers. No recurring license change, just professional services + possible higher support tier.
aleks (security): If they want us to sign artifacts with our key, legal will need key-escrow agreement and we need to capture an audit trail. Preferable: they supply a KMS public key and we sign locally with their key or provide unsigned bundle + verification tooling.
release-bot: release rb-20260401-airgap-demo created (rb-id: 20260401-99) :package:
lina (solutions): I'll prepare a short ops runbook and a checklist for cert rotation, SBOM, and KMS flow. Can demo micro-bundle apply/rollback.
tom (sales-eng): I'll draft the POC SOW line items: one-time packaging fee, runbook delivery, and a 1-day on-call for cutover.
maria (sales): Action items: 1) I'll ask Nimbus which transfer workflow they prefer and their maintenance window constraints. 2) Tom to draft SOW. 3) Lina to prep runbook + demo. 4) Aleks to prepare security checklist and KMS options.
aleks (security): I'll include FIPS requirement questions and suggested audit log retention defaults.
maria (sales): Thanks all, I'll get answers and schedule a 30-min technical walkthrough with Nimbus next week. :thumbsup:
